criteria.evidence: Opens with "Don't rely on the LLM or the prompt to be careful. Enforce safety in the tool code"; LLM only gets request_delete, which never deletes, and can't self-approve.
criteria.criterion: Do not treat the LLM decision as authorization.

criteria.evidence: "Authorize as the end user, not the agent"; code calls authz.can_delete(user, ids) for tenant and permission; execute_deletion verifies the approval token bound to the plan.
Multiple safeguards: dry run, human out-of-band approval, soft delete, max batch size, rate limits, snapshot, audit log, idempotency, alerting, and prompt-injection guard.
criteria.criterion: Apply additional safeguards to destructive actions.
